sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate still treats airReceiverCapacity as presence-only and never encodes the required sufficiency relationship between air-receiver capacity and compressor charging performance. Preserve the ship-owned airReceiverCapacity quantity with its declared QuantityValue and cubic-metre unit, and add the required relationship/path structure without inventing a formula or canonical term. The conditional alternatives now correctly cover IA Super with reversal=true at <=0.5 h and all other cases at <=1 h; retain those inclusive bounds.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: The candidate omits the declared required input airReceiverCapacity_Nm3, so it does not faithfully encode the requirement that compressor capacity be sufficient to charge the air receivers. Locate and use the canonical air-receiver-capacity term, target it on the supplied ship owner, and add its declared datatype/unit and relationship structure as required. Retain the existing inclusive conditional limits of 0.5 hour for IA Super with reversal true and 1 hour otherwise.

The conditional charge-time logic is correctly encoded, but the required airReceiverCapacity obligation is reduced to presence of an independently typed quantity. Faithfully encode the stated sufficiency relationship between compressor capacity/charge performance and the ship's air-receiver capacity, using the declared ship-owned airReceiverCapacity term and required relationship structure; do not treat merely supplying a cubic-metre value as satisfying that requirement. Preserve the existing IA Super plus reversal=true limit of <=0.5 h and the otherwise limit of <=1 h.

Repair the candidate before freezing. Preserve the required ship-owned airReceiverCapacity quantity, but do not encode it as presence-only: faithfully encode the stated sufficiency relationship between air-receiver capacity and compressor charging performance using the required owner/path relationship structure. Also fix the conditional alternatives: the <=1 hour otherwise branch must cover every non-IA-Super ice class regardless of whether propulsionEngineReversalRequiredForAstern is true or false. The current alternatives omit non-IA-Super ships with reversal=false. Retain the IA Super plus reversal=true <=0.5 hour branch and the inclusive quantity units and bounds. No vocabulary matcher is needed because all required canonical terms are already supplied and used.

The candidate still treats airReceiverCapacity as presence-only and never encodes the required sufficiency relationship between air-receiver capacity and compressor charging performance. Preserve the ship-owned airReceiverCapacity quantity with its declared QuantityValue and cubic-metre unit, and add the required relationship/path structure without inventing a formula or canonical term. The conditional alternatives now correctly cover IA Super with reversal=true at <=0.5 h and all other cases at <=1 h; retain those inclusive bounds.
